description: Main FastAPI server implementation for Subtitle Sync Platform backend. Defines API endpoints for user auth, file uploads, subtitle processing jobs, administrative listings, and external hooks.

methods.name: register_user( username: str = Form(..., description="Unique username"), password: str = Form(..., description="Password"), db=Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with username and password.

methods.name: login_for_access_token(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user and generate JWT token.

methods.name: upload_video( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video File"), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db=Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a video file and initiate a processing job.

methods.name: upload_subtitle( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle File (SRT, VTT, etc.)"), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db=Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a subtitle file for validation or processing.

methods.name: generate_subtitles( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, video_file_id: str = Form(..., description="FileID for video"), language: str = Form(..., description="Target language for subtitle"), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db=Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Request generation of subtitles using LLM for a specific video.

methods.name: translate_subtitles( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, subtitle_file_id: str = Form(..., description="FileID for subtitle"), target_language: str = Form(..., description="Target language"), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db=Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Request translation of subtitles to another language.

methods.name: compliance_check( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, subtitle_file_id: str = Form(..., description="FileID for subtitle"), platform: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Compliance platform/standard"), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db=Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Run compliance checks on subtitle files.

methods.name: job_status(job_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve the status and logs of a specific job.

methods.name: download_file(file_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Download processed files like subtitles or videos.

methods.name: admin_list_jobs(current_user: User = Depends(get_admin_user), db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Admin endpoint to list all jobs for audit.

methods.name: admin_list_users(current_user: User = Depends(get_admin_user), db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Admin endpoint to list all users.

methods.name: admin_list_files(current_user: User = Depends(get_admin_user), db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Admin endpoint to list all uploaded/processed files.

methods.name: external_webhook(event: dict)
methods.description: Accepts event webhooks from external services.

methods.name: websocket_docs()
methods.description: Provides info about real-time websocket updates (not implemented).

methods.name: global_exception_handler(request, exc)
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions, logs error, returns 500.
